name: Moonraker Printer
author: prodpixa
description: 3D printer status for any Klipper/Moonraker printer: progress, time left, and temperatures in the bar with a detail panel, the printer's camera, and filament changer lanes.

barWidget.description: Moonraker print progress, time remaining, and temperatures. Left click for details and settings, right click to cycle the bar display, middle click to open the printer's web UI.

schema.label: Moonraker URL
schema.description: Address of the printer, e.g. http://192.168.1.50 or http://printer.local:7125.

schema.label: API key
schema.description: Moonraker API key (Mainsail/Fluidd: Settings > Authorization). Needed when the printer does not trust your address, e.g. over a VPN.

schema.label: Bar display
schema.description: icon: icon only · progress: percent and time left · full: progress plus temperatures.

schema.label: Chamber sensor object
schema.description: Optional Klipper object for the chamber temperature. Auto-detected when empty.

schema.label: Compact when not printing
schema.description: Show only a dimmed icon until a print starts. The widget stays clickable.

schema.label: Hide when not printing
schema.description: Hide the widget completely until a print starts. Its settings can then only be changed in shell.json or over IPC.

schema.label: Hide when the printer is offline
Show camera
schema.description: Show the printer's webcam in the popup. Snapshots are fetched about once a second, and only while the popup is open.

schema.label: Webcam name
schema.description: Which webcam to show, as named in Mainsail/Fluidd. The first one when empty. Click the picture to switch.

schema.label: Show filament
schema.description: For printers with an AFC filament changer (Box Turtle, Elegoo Canvas, …): show the lanes, the loaded spool, and tool changes in the popup.
